objectives: Design and implement a fully digital loan approval platform.
Significantly reduce personal loan application processing time.
Improve operational efficiency by automating repetitive tasks.
Maintain high accuracy and transparency in decision-making.
Enhance customer experience with faster feedback, real-time tracking, and a seamless digital journey.
dependencies: Risk assessment depends on defined business rules.
Approval workflow depends on integration of all components.
timeline: The project timeline spans from Week 1 (Stakeholder alignment and requirement validation) to Week 12 (Final delivery, Internal Demo, Testing, compliance checks, and bug fixing). MVP Delivery is targeted for Week 9.
